title: PixelKin - The Wakeful Fair (Seeing Things)
_note: Twelve cups: the urn is singing. The same tune at 120 but wrong in all the nice ways: every 'pah' chord augmented, the bass rocking root-to-tritone, the long notes of bars 4/8/12/16 sliding up a semitone, a ghost of the tune one beat behind on pulse12 (a canon that never quite lines up), whole-tone bell runs drifting over the top. Still hummable; still loops.
